mapper.select: SELECT rs.registrable_stock_id AS registrableStockId, rs.general_account_id AS generalAccountId, ga.account_type AS accountType, rs.foreign_product_id AS foreignProductId, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rs2.held_qty), 0) FROM registrable_stock rs2 JOIN general_account ga2 ON rs2.general_account_id = ga2.general_account_id JOIN general_customer gc2 ON ga2.general_customer_id = gc2.general_customer_id WHERE gc2.ci_hash = #{ciHash} AND rs2.foreign_product_id = #{foreignProductId}) AS heldQty, rs.source_broker AS sourceBroker, rs.recorded_at AS recordedAt, rs.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, rs.purchase_price AS purchasePrice, rs.purchase_currency AS purchaseCurrency, rs.purchase_fx_rate AS purchaseFxRate FROM registrable_stock rs JOIN general_account ga ON rs.general_account_id = ga.general_account_id JOIN general_customer gc ON ga.general_customer_id = gc.general_customer_id WHERE gc.ci_hash = #{ciHash} AND rs.foreign_product_id = #{foreignProductId} ORDER BY rs.purchase_date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT rs.registrable_stock_id AS registrableStockId, rs.general_account_id AS generalAccountId, ga.account_type AS accountType, rs.foreign_product_id AS foreignProductId, rs.held_qty AS heldQty, rs.source_broker AS sourceBroker, rs.recorded_at AS recordedAt, rs.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, rs.purchase_price AS purchasePrice, rs.purchase_currency AS purchaseCurrency, rs.purchase_fx_rate AS purchaseFxRate FROM registrable_stock rs JOIN general_account ga ON rs.general_account_id = ga.general_account_id JOIN general_customer gc ON ga.general_customer_id = gc.general_customer_id WHERE gc.ci_hash = #{ciHash} AND rs.foreign_product_id = #{foreignProductId} ORDER BY rs.purchase_date ASC
